final: SELECT AVG(avg_rebate), AVG(avg_net_rate), AVG(avg_net_rate - benchmark) FROM (SELECT orderslink, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink) AS per_order CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(avg_net_rate) AS benchmark FROM (SELECT orderslink, AVG(feerate - rebrate) AS avg_net_rate FROM fees GROUP BY orderslink)) AS b WHERE avg_net_rate > benchmark
